framework: EU AI Act (Reg. (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744)

who_tests: Providers and deployers of Annex III high-risk systems (obligation holders); national authorities enforce

framework: EU AI Act (Reg. (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744)
requirement_paraphrase: Chapter III Sections 1-3 apply from 2 August 2028 for AI systems classified high-risk under Art. 6(1) and Annex I (AI as safety component of, or itself, a regulated product requiring third-party conformity assessment).

framework: EU AI Act (Reg. (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744)

framework: EU AI Act (Reg. (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744)
requirement_paraphrase: High-risk systems placed on the market before the Chapter III application date are covered only if they undergo significant design changes after that date; providers and deployers of high-risk systems intended for use by public authorities must take steps to comply by 2 August 2030.
who_tests: Providers and deployers; public-authority deployers have the 2030 backstop
document_to_download: Download consolidated Art 111 and the amending act point amending Art 111 (OJ L 24.7.2026 pages 30-41) and confirm; until then mark unverified.

framework: EU AI Act (Reg. (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744)
requirement_paraphrase: GPAI model providers with models placed on market before 2 Aug 2025 must comply by 2 Aug 2027; providers of generative systems placed on market before 2 Aug 2026 must comply with Art. 50(2) marking by 2 Dec 2026.
what_is_tested: Transitional compliance dates for legacy GPAI models and generative systems
who_tests: GPAI model providers; generative AI system providers
document_to_download: Read Art. 111 in the OJ L 2026/1744 text or consolidated text beyond the fetch cutoff; confirm both dates and that 111(4) is new.

framework: EU AI Act (Reg. (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744)
requirement_paraphrase: Commission was required to issue high-risk classification guidelines with practical examples by 2 Feb 2026; Art. 6(5) is carved out of the postponement of Chapter III.

framework: EU AI Act (Reg. (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744)
requirement_paraphrase: High-risk systems must comply with the Section 2 requirements taking account of intended purpose and the generally acknowledged state of the art, with the Art. 9 risk management system taken into account.

framework: EU AI Act (Reg. (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744)
requirement_paraphrase: High-risk systems trained and tested on data reflecting the specific geographical, behavioural, contextual or functional setting of intended use are presumed to meet Art. 10(4).
document_to_download: Read Art. 42(1) in the OJ or consolidated text beyond the fetch cutoff.

framework: EU AI Act (Reg. (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744)
clause_or_page: Art. 11(1) with Annex IV point 2(g) and point 4

framework: EU AI Act (Reg. (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744)
requirement_paraphrase: High-risk systems certified under an EU cybersecurity scheme (Reg. 2019/881) with references published in the OJ are presumed to meet Art. 15 cybersecurity requirements to the extent covered; systems within Reg. 2024/2847 (Cyber Resilience Act) scope are deemed to comply with Art. 15 cybersecurity requirements where conditions are met.
what_is_tested: Cybersecurity conformity via other EU instruments
who_tests: Provider; certifying bodies under other EU regimes

framework: EU AI Act (Reg. (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744)
requirement_paraphrase: Deployers must retain system-generated logs under their control for at least six months (unless other law provides) and public-authority deployers must not use a high-risk system not registered in the EU database.
what_is_tested: Log retention; registration check before use
